Title: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
Description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

Title: Board independence and oversight
Description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight.

Title: Structure and reporting lines
Description: Management establishes structures reporting lines and appropriate authorities/responsibilities.

Title: Commitment to competence
Description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract develop and retain competent individuals.

Title: Accountability
Description: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

Title: Relevant quality information
Description: The entity obtains/generates and uses relevant quality information to support internal control.

Title: Internal communication
Description: The entity internally communicates information necessary to support internal control.

Title: External communication
Description: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting internal control.

Title: Objectives with clarity
Description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable risk identification/assessment.

Title: Risk identification and analysis
Description: The entity identifies risks to achievement of objectives and analyzes risks for management.

Title: Fraud risk consideration
Description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.

Title: Assessing changes
Description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact internal control.

Title: Ongoing/separate evaluations
Description: The entity selects/develops/performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations of controls.

Title: Evaluating and communicating deficiencies
Description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies to responsible parties.

Title: Selecting control activities
Description: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risk to acceptable levels.

Title: Technology general controls
Description: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.

Title: Policies and procedures deployment
Description: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Logical access security measures
Description: The entity implements logical access security software/infrastructure/architecture over protected information assets.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: User registration and authorization
Description: The entity registers and authorizes new internal/external users prior to granting system access.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Role-based access management
Description: The entity uses role-based access and authorizes modification/removal of access based on roles.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Physical access restriction
Description: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Discontinuing protections
Description: The entity discontinues logical/physical protections over data assets no longer required.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Boundary protection
Description: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from outside system boundaries.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Data transmission restriction
Description: The entity restricts the transmission/movement/removal of information to authorized users/processes.

Category: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access
Title: Malicious software prevention
Description: The entity implements controls to prevent/detect and act upon unauthorized/malicious software.

Title: Vulnerability detection
Description: The entity uses detection/monitoring procedures to identify configuration changes/vulnerabilities.

Title: Anomaly monitoring
Description: The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts/errors.

Title: Security incident evaluation
Description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they represent a security incident.

Title: Incident response
Description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined response program.

Title: Recovery from incidents
Description: The entity identifies/develops/implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

Title: Change management process
Description: The entity authorizes/designs/develops/tests/approves and implements changes to infrastructure/software.

Title: Business disruption risk mitigation
Description: The entity identifies/develops/implements risk mitigation activities for business disruptions.

Title: Vendor and business partner risk
Description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.

Title: Capacity management
Description: The entity maintains monitors current processing capacity/use to manage availability.

Title: Environmental protections and recovery infrastructure
Description: The entity authorizes/designs/develops/implements environmental protections software backup and recovery infrastructure.

Title: Recovery plan testing
Description: The entity tests recovery plan procedures to support achievement of availability commitments.

Title: Confidential information identification
Description: The entity identifies and maintains confidential information to meet the entity's objectives.

Title: Confidential information disposal
Description: The entity disposes of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives.

Title: Processing integrity objectives
Description: The entity obtains/uses information regarding objectives relevant to processing integrity.

Title: System input controls
Description: The entity implements policies/procedures over system inputs including completeness/accuracy.

Title: System processing controls
Description: The entity implements policies/procedures over system processing to meet objectives.

Title: System output controls
Description: The entity implements policies/procedures over system output including completeness/accuracy/timeliness.

Title: Storage of inputs and outputs
Description: The entity implements policies/procedures to store inputs/outputs completely/accurately/timely.
